home.gameDescription: A math puzzle game where you combine four number cards with +, −, ×, ÷ to make 24, solo or against friends

faq.whatAnswer: The 24 game is a math puzzle: use 4 number cards (1 to 13) with addition, subtraction, multiplication and division so the result equals 24.
faq.rulesQuestion: What are the rules of the 24 game?
faq.rulesAnswer: Pick number cards and operators from your hand to build an equation that equals 24. + and − score 1 point, × scores 2 and ÷ scores 3, so harder operations earn more.
faq.howQuestion: How do I play the 24 game?
faq.howAnswer: Open Math24 Master and choose single player or multiplayer. Select number cards from your hand, combine them with + − × ÷ and parentheses, and play an equation that equals 24 to score.

scoring.s1: Each + or − in your equation scores 1 pt
scoring.s4: Using two × adds +1 pt; two ÷ adds +1 pt

buzzer.goal1: Use the 4 shared cards with + − × ÷ to make 24
buzzer.goal2: The first player to reach the target score (20 by default) wins
buzzer.flow1: Each round deals 4 shared cards (the same set for everyone)
buzzer.flow2: Any player who isn't locked out can hit the buzzer to answer
buzzer.flow3: Once you buzz in, build and submit your equation within the answer time
buzzer.flow4: A correct answer scores and starts the next round; a wrong answer or timeout loses points and locks you out
buzzer.lockout1: Wrong answer or timeout: lose points (0–3, per room settings) and get locked out
buzzer.lockout2: While locked out you can't buzz in, and your streak resets
buzzer.lockout3: If "Unlock each round" is on, lockouts clear when a new round starts
buzzer.streak2: With streak bonus on, each correct answer adds streak × 1 or × 2 pts
buzzer.streak3: A wrong answer or timeout resets your streak
buzzer.noSolution1: If you think the 4 cards can't make 24, vote "No solution"
buzzer.noSolution2: Once more than half the players vote, a new set is dealt with no penalty
buzzer.roundTimeout1: If the round timer runs out with no correct answer, every player loses points per room settings
buzzer.roundTimeout2: A new set is dealt for the next round

classic.goal1: You always hold 4 number cards (values 1–13). Use + − × ÷ to make 24
classic.goal2: Keep playing hands to rack up points until the deck runs out
classic.flow1: You must use all 4 cards at once, and the result must equal 24 to score
classic.flow2: After a correct answer, you draw a fresh hand automatically
classic.flow3: Can't make 24? Press "Skip hand" to redraw (we try to make sure the new hand is solvable)
classic.flow4: When the deck is empty you play one final hand, then the game ends
classic.perfect1: Score the highest possible points for a hand (a perfect solution) to earn a +1 bonus
classic.perfect2: At the end, your efficiency (total ÷ max possible) earns an S / A / B / C grade

challenge.goal1: Within a 5-minute countdown, use 4 number cards with + − × ÷ to make 24
challenge.goal2: Clear as many stages as you can. There's no limit
challenge.time1: Each correct answer adds time and moves you to the next stage
challenge.time2: Stage 1 adds 60 s, then 3 s less each stage, down to 15 s
challenge.skip1: Can't make 24? Skip to a new puzzle, but it costs time
challenge.skip2: Within a stage, the 1st skip costs 15 s, the 2nd 30 s, and every skip after that 60 s
challenge.skip3: A correct answer resets your skip count
challenge.end1: The game ends when time runs out, or when you press "End early"
challenge.end2: Your result is your final stage and total score; your best stage is saved

match.goal1: You're dealt 16 random number cards (values 1–13) in a 4×4 grid
match.goal2: Pick any 2–4 cards and make 24 with + − × ÷ to clear them
match.goal3: Your goal is to clear all 16 cards. There's no time limit
match.flow1: Pick cards from anywhere on the board. They don't need to be adjacent
match.flow2: Cleared cards disappear, and their spots aren't refilled
match.flow3: Don't like the board? Press "New game" for a fresh deal, as often as you like
match.end1: Full clear (all 16 cards): your score goes on the leaderboard
match.end2: Stuck (no 2–4 remaining cards make 24): the game ends and doesn't count for the leaderboard

tabletop.intro: Adapted from the board game Rummikub: play cards to a shared table, break up and rearrange sets, and try to empty your hand first. The twist: every set has to make 24
tabletop.rule1: You and 2 bots take turns. Everyone starts with 10 cards and doesn't refill after playing; if you can't play, draw 1
tabletop.rule2: Each turn, complete one set: 3–5 cards that make 24 with + − × ÷ and parentheses. You can rearrange sets on the table, but every card you play from your hand this turn must go into the same set, and every set on the table must be valid when your turn ends
tabletop.rule3: Colors: 3–4 card sets must be one color or all different colors; 5-card sets must be one color. A Joker's value and color are declared when it's played; if its set is broken up, it resets and the next player to use it declares again
tabletop.rule4: Scoring: a set scores 1 per + or −, 2 per ×, 3 per ÷, +1 for 4 cards and +2 for 5 cards, then a color multiplier (one color ×2, all different ×1.5). Your Turn Score is however much the Table Score rises above its previous high, with at least 1 pt per card played from your hand
tabletop.rule5: The game ends when someone empties their hand (or after a Final Round once the deck runs out). The first to go out gets +10; everyone else loses 1 pt per card left and 5 per Joker. Highest total wins
